images.name: cover
images.title: Is an *AI Employee* safe with customer data?
images.sub: Where the data goes, the risks that are new with AI, and the controls to set before it gets a login.

images.name: where-data-goes
images.title: Where customer data goes, and *what to check*
head: What happens there
What to check
rows: Your systems
It reads and writes in the inbox, calendar, CRM and accounts
Its own login, with only the permissions the role needs
The AI model
Text is sent to a model provider to draft and read
A business plan with no training on your data
Its memory and logs
It keeps notes and a record of everything it did
Who can read them and how long they're kept
images.source: The business stays responsible for the data at every stop

images.name: controls
images.title: The controls that keep *customer data in place*
steps: Its own account in every system
Never a shared login, so every action traces back and can be shut off.
Read-only where it only looks things up. No export or delete rights.
Documents only go to the contact already on file.
A person signs off before files leave the business.
Daily in the first month, then weekly.

images.name: authority
images.title: What it can do with data, and *who approves it*
rows: Clinic: look up an appointment time
Confirms the time with the patient after checking identity
alone
Property manager: update a phone number
Changes the record and notes the old number in the log
reports
Law firm: send a file to a new address
Holds it and flags the mismatch to the assigned lawyer
asks
Accounting firm: change banking details
Never from an email. A person confirms by phone
asks
Online store: export the customer list
Passes the request to the owner. Its account can't export
asks

images.name: questions
images.title: Questions to ask before you *give it a login*
head: Question
A good answer
rows: Which AI model company processes our data?
A named provider, on a business plan
Is our data used to train models?
No, in writing
How long is our data kept, and where?
A set retention period you can read
What can its account open, change and delete?
A written list of permissions per system
What needs a person's approval?
Anything that sends data outside the business
Will you sign our agreement?
Yes, including a business associate agreement for health data
images.source: Get every answer in writing before customer data goes in
